criteria.requirement: Add independent wrapt.canonical_cache.canonical_cache(maxsize=128,typed=False,key_func=None). inspect.signature.bind/apply_defaults before key creation so equivalent positional/keyword/explicit-default calls share, varargs remain ordered and varkw keys sort deterministically. typed mode includes direct bound value types. Custom key_func receives BoundArguments after signature validation and may extract id from unhashable dict; collisions are explicit caller policy. Default unhashable values fail, never deepcopy/serialize arbitrary inputs. Bounded LRU, cache_info/clear, exception propagation and ordinary metadata/descriptor binding; synchronous RLock serializes. Existing lru_cache key behavior unchanged.
